title: Biggersville hands North Pontotoc boys their first home loss, 56–54
excerpt: The Vikings finished a three-game week 2–1. After home wins over Nettleton, Lafayette and Byhalia, they lost by two in Ecru and head to Saltillo on Monday.
locality: North Pontotoc High School in Ecru, Mississippi.

paragraphs.text: Biggersville beat North Pontotoc 56–54 on Friday in Ecru, handing the Vikings their first home loss of the boys basketball season. North Pontotoc finished the week with two road wins and a home loss, moving to 6–2 overall.

The Vikings had won their first three in Ecru by at least eight points. They beat Nettleton 63–55 on opening night, Lafayette 51–27 and Byhalia 73–57. Their only other loss this season came at Houston on Nov. 13.

Friday was the third straight game North Pontotoc played to a margin of five points or fewer. The Vikings held Alcorn Central to 26 points in a 31–26 win Tuesday, then beat Water Valley 53–48 on Thursday. They scored one more point against Biggersville the following night.

North Pontotoc travels to Saltillo for a noon game Monday, Nov. 23. The Tigers enter at 0–3. Two of their losses were within five points, 49–46 at Byers and 47–42 at home against Itawamba Agricultural.
